title: Beef and sweet potato mash
summary: Tender ground beef mashed into sweet potato: a soft, iron-rich meal that's easy to batch cook.
texture: Lumpy and soft, like a thick mash with small, tender pieces of beef. Blend briefly for a smoother texture if baby is still getting used to lumps.
ingredients: 1 medium sweet potato, peeled and cubed
steps: Steam or boil the sweet potato for 12 to 15 minutes until very soft.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a pan and cook the beef over medium heat, breaking it up into the smallest crumbs you can, for 6 to 8 minutes until no pink remains (160°F / 71°C).
Add the water to the pan and simmer for 5 minutes to make the beef extra tender.
Mash the sweet potato and stir in the beef with its cooking liquid. Pulse briefly in a food processor for a finer texture.
choking: Break the beef into very fine crumbs. Larger chunks of meat are hard for babies to chew.
Simmering in water keeps the meat moist; dry meat crumbs are harder to swallow.
storage: Fridge up to 2 days in a sealed container, or freeze in an ice-cube tray, then bag the cubes, up to 1 month. Thaw in the fridge and warm gently. Stir and check the temperature before serving.
tips: Red meat is one of the best sources of iron for babies.
Swap the beef for ground turkey or chicken thigh.
